title: iPhone Magnifier and Voice over
summary: Kristy Viers demonstrates the iPhone Magnifier combined with VoiceOver to describe the user's surroundings. She shows how the built-in feature reports scenes, faces and lighting.
why: HN recommends it to show what on-device accessibility features can do and how blind users actually use an iPhone.

quote.text: It describes the scene, tells you how many faces are visible, whether or not the image is focused, lighting conditions.
